Hands-on exercises built on the [Site Data Dictionary](/docs/data-dictionary.html)
portfolio. Each brief is written for a specific unit and uses the same synthetic
CloudCore datasets you can download from the dictionary — every link below works
with `pandas.read_csv()`, R, or a spreadsheet.

::: {.callout-note}
## How to work through an exercise

1. Download the linked CSV files (they are plain UTF-8).
2. Do the work in pandas, R, or a spreadsheet — the starter code is a floor,
   not a ceiling.
3. Produce the deliverable as if CloudCore were your client: concise,
   evidence-linked, and honest about uncertainty.

There are no model answers on the site — the *designed relationships* in the
data are what you are meant to interrogate.
:::
